#### Drug effects:

+-------------------+---------------------------------+-------------------------------+
|                   | **Sevoflurane (SF)**            | **Fentanyl (F)**              |
+===================+=================================+===============================+
| Amnesia           | MAC 0.25                        | Unreliable even at high Ce    |
+-------------------+---------------------------------+                               |
| Hypnosis          | MAC 0.3                         |                               |
+-------------------+---------------------------------+-------------------------------+
| Immobility        | MAC 1                           | No                            |
+-------------------+---------------------------------+-------------------------------+
| Analgesia         | No                              | Yes                           |
+-------------------+---------------------------------+-------------------------------+
| CVS side effects  | ↓HR, ↓contractility, ↓SVR, ↓mAP | ↓SNS output → ↓HR, ↓SVR, ↓mAP |
+-------------------+---------------------------------+-------------------------------+
| Resp side effects | ↑RR, ↓TV                        | ↓RR, ↓TV                      |
+-------------------+---------------------------------+-------------------------------+
| Other             | PONV                            | PONV                          |
|                   |                                 |                               |
|                   | ↑Uterine blood flow +/- PPH     | Sedation                      |
|                   |                                 |                               |
|                   | ↑Cerebral blood flow +/- ICP    |                               |
+-------------------+---------------------------------+-------------------------------+

#### Pharmacodynamics:

+-------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+
| Complementary                 | - SF: anaesthesia                                                                                                                                         |
|                               | - F: analgesia                                                                                                                                            |
+-------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Synergistic                   | - Combined effect exceeds sum of individual effects                                                                                                       |
|                               | - Represented by isobologram (or response surface)                                                                                                        |
|                               | - Mechanism: ? F reduces nociceptive activation of ascending reticular activating system (ARAS)                                                           |
|                               |                                                                                                                                                           |
|                               | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2009/B/1/prize-image001.jpg){fig-alt="Isobologram showing infra-additive, additive and synergistic drug interactions"}           |
+-------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Implications of synergism     | - ↓SF % for hypnosis and immobility                                                                                                                       |
|                               | - ↓MAC standard deviation → ↓variability                                                                                                                  |
|                               | - ↓SF side effects                                                                                                                                        |
|                               | - ↓Need for paralysis                                                                                                                                     |
+-------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+
| Quantification of interaction |                                                   | **SF alone**                                      | **SF + F 3ng/mL**                                 |
|                               +---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+
|                               | MACBAR                                            | 4.15%                                             | ↓80%                                              |
|                               +---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+
|                               | MAC                                               | 1.85%                                             | ↓60%                                              |
|                               +---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+
|                               | MACawake                                          | 0.6%                                              | ↓25%                                              |
|                               +---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+
|                               | Standard deviation                                | 0.1MAC                                            | \<0.1MAC (not from this stud                      |
|                               +---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------+
|                               | <https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/9447851>                                                                                                             |
|                               |                                                                                                                                                           |

#### Pharmacokinetics:

+---------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
| Lack of interference      | - Plasma protein binding sites:                      |
|                           |   - Fentanyl to AAG \> albumin                       |
|                           |   - Sevoflurane uptake to proteins, lipids, RBCs     |
|                           | - Metabolism:                                        |
|                           |   - SF → liver CYP2E1 (only 2-5%)                    |
|                           |   - F → liver CYP3A4 (almost 100%)                   |
|                           | - Excretion:                                         |
|                           |   - SF via lungs                                     |
|                           |   - F metabolites via urine                          |
+---------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
| Implications of synergism | - For a given desired effect, ↓\[SF\] and ↓\[F\]     |
|                           | - ↓compartmental concentrations                      |
|                           | - ↓total dose, ↓accumulation                         |
|                           | - ↓time to emergence (since MAC awake less affected) |
+---------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+

#### Pharmaceutics:

  --------------- ---------------------------------
  Compatibility   None: F intravenous, SF inhaled
  Efficiency      Synergism → ↓total dose → ↓cost
  --------------- ---------------------------------
